about: What B1's builder (scripts/build-bundle.mjs) puts in the two data sets, by TeX Live package name (docs/DESIGN.md#engine-and-data). A collection brings its packages, not the collections it depends on; a package brings the packages it depends on; 'match' takes every package whose name matches. extra-data is everything it names minus core-data. Each set's licence rule: 'free' takes only packages whose Catalogue licences are all free (and TeX Live's own files); a group may narrow it with 'licences' (regular expressions over the Catalogue's licence names), and its 'readFirst' names Catalogue labels ('none' for no licence at all) whose packages come in only once their files are read and recorded in 'licenceReviews'. A package that fails the rule is left out and listed in the report; in core-data it is an error. A set's 'exclude' leaves a package out on purpose, with the reason, which the report lists; core-data's 'toExtra' leaves a package out of core-data, also as a dependency, and puts it in extra-data instead; its 'forOwnDocuments' names the packages the extension's own templates and example presets load, which core-data must hold (test/engine/newDocuments.test.ts and presetModes.test.ts compile each with core-data alone). core-data's Type 1 fonts are stored packed with t1c (decrypted, and restored to the original bytes when TeX reads them), except those of the packages its 't1cSkip' names, with the reason: fonts whose licence does not plainly cover a stored form. 'licenceReviews' give the licences of packages the Catalogue calls a 'collection' (files under several licences), as read in the files of the pinned snapshot's archives; a collection with no review counts as not free. A set's 'leaveOut' (package: each file and its reason) leaves named run files out of data/ for a package it keeps, such as a script nothing reads at run time; LICENSE.txt lists each with its reason, and a licence reading can still ship one in LICENSES/. Each set's 'fontOrder' names, for a name two of its font files share (a PostScript name, a full name, or a family and style), the file whose face comes first in its font list (scripts/lib/font-list.mjs), with the reason; the builder stops on a shared name with no rule, on a name the two sets share, and on a rule that does not hold or decides nothing.
